in_hebrew.name: Erine
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erine הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Erine is a goddess associated with the dawn, the light of the sun, and the healing power of the divine. In Christianity, Erine is a name derived from the Greek word 'eranos', meaning 'beloved' or 'dear'. This name is a reminder of God's unending love and the light of His grace.
